dogecoin.text: @Aaron2644 @BTCjunkies The charm of Dogecoin lies in that it gives more ordinary people the opportunity to participate and makes them feel that they can get a fair chance to compete in this market.

@jacobordenstein @elonmusk One of DOGE's greatest strengths is that its supply isn't strictly capped like Bitcoin's. Dogecoin's annual inflation rate is relatively high, primarily due to the issuance of approximately 5 billion DOGE each year.
